The Route Shirt Dress from Houdini is a functional and simplistic dress in feather soft recycled polyester to wear to the beach, when you're out camping or travelling. A central part of the Houdini design philosophy is making things that last. Garments that by their high quality, versatile functionality and timeless looks simply don't need to be replaced. The shirt is made in Wish Woven, a super light polyester fabric made from 70% recycled and 100% recyclable fibers. It has a good stretch and an incredibly soft touch against the skin. It dries in no time, making it perfect to wear on top of your swimwear. The light fabric is highly packable and it can be stowed in the side pocket. We can recommend Route Shirt Dress if you are looking for a comfortable dress to wear for any summer adventure. It can tag along both to the mountain and the beach for many years to come.

We can recommend Daybreak Shorts if you are looking for a pair of tough outdoor shorts for anything from boulder climbing to week long hikes.

Chipo is a jacket designed in a relaxed fit with a regular sleeve length and dropped shoulders. This jacket is made from recycled leather in a quilted fabric. Chipo is easy to style together with denim, skirts, and dresses. It’s decorated with black Rodebjer-logo press buttons at front, flap pockets at both sides and cuffs and the end of each sleeve. It’s produced with sustainability in mind, made from real leather that has been wasted from previous productions. The leather has been recycled, grinded, washed and reactivated. The result is a textile product that can be marked as genuine leather and has the properties of a fabric. The name “Second life” comes from this process of regeneration. Designed for a loose fit: for a more narrow fit go one size smaller

The latest innovation from Houdini and Polartec® is not only made to keep you warm and dry on any adventure. The Mono Air fabric is specifically designed to combat plastic waste. It sheds 80% less microfibers compared to conventional fleece and is made from recycled and recyclable materials. A fleece that is both anti-shedding and circular is nothing less than groundbreaking. When you feel the warmth on a cold mountain hike or a chilly morning at the climbing crag, you should also feel the comfort of contributing to a world without waste. In a conventional fleece, the cut-off fibers that create the fuzzy structure are exposed and can therefore shed from the garment during wash or when you use it. In Mono Air, endlessly long and lofty fibers are knitted into small pockets between a face and back fabric. The pockets trap warm air from your body to create insulation and at the same time protect the insulating fibers from escaping. The face of the fabric is reinforced with a hardface treatment that prevent pilling and snagging. The result is a smooth and strong fabric that will keep you warm and endure years of hard use. The Mono Air Jacket is a lightweight insulation garment for four season use. The light, stretchy and durable fabric works perfectly as an outer layer or as insulation underneath a ski jacket or a winter coat. Mono Air Crew has been field tested for ski touring, rock climbing, alpine trekking, and many other demanding adventures. The snug collar and the densely knitted face fabric takes the worst edge of the wind but the garment is still highly breathable and easy to vent thanks to the front zipper. Treat it well and it will become a lifelong companion.

You will barely feel that you're wearing Weather Tee, but that extra protection will keep you warm, comfy and well ventilated at all times. The shirt is made in C9 Ripstop, an ultra light, strong and highly breathable material. It has the perfect air permeability to let your body breathe but still take the edge of a cold draft or sudden gusts of wind. The fabric is made from 70% recycled polyester and 30% polyester. It’s completely recyclable.

The Omni Pants from Houdini may look like a classic pair of chinos, but it’s when you put them on that you feel the difference. The light, stretchy fabric gives you an immediate feeling of comfort. With a regular fit and pre-bent knees, Omni Pants never hinder your movement. The fabric is light, but it’s also surprisingly strong. Perfect for climbers, bicycle commuters or anyone else that needs clothes that are both light and tough. The adjustable leg endings let you keep your pants out of the way of your climbing shoes or bicycle chain. The fabric Thrill Twill is a trusted Houdini Classic tested over many years. It is a blend of 41% recycled polyester, 38% virgin polyester and 21% stretch polyester. The fabric is dense enough to shelter you a little bit from wind, but also light and open enough to provide high breathability. It is fully recyclable. If you are looking for a pair of clean, timeless chinos that works perfectly for climbing but also blend into your everyday wardrobe, this is your match.

The Mono Air Houdi from Houdini is an innovation both in terms of performance and sustainability. The Mono Air fabric is specifically designed to combat plastic waste. It sheds 80% less microfibers compared to conventional fleece and is made from recycled and recyclable materials. A fleece that is both anti-shedding and circular is nothing less than groundbreaking. When you feel the warmth on a cold ski tour in the backcountry, when you snuggle up during a coffee break at the climbing crag, you should also feel the comfort of contributing to a world without waste. In a conventional fleece, the cut-off fibers that create the fuzzy structure are exposed and can therefore shed from the garment during wash or when you use it. In Mono Air, endlessly long and lofty fibers are knitted into small pockets between a face and back fabric. The pockets trap warm air from your body to create insulation and at the same time protect the insulating fibers from escaping. The face of the fabric is reinforced with a hardface treatment that prevent pilling and snagging. The result is a smooth and strong fabric that will keep you warm and endure years of hard use.

Your best friend on a rainy day. Meet BFF Jacket from Houdini, a waterproof and breathable shell jacket in a minimalistic form. It’s the perfect four season adventure buddy and works for everything from hiking, kayaking to even ski touring. BFF Jacket is called best friends forever because it’s designed to be your everyday adventure partner. The waterproof and breathable shell will keep you sheltered from both summer rains and winter blizzards. It’s made from recycled and recyclable polyester and both the membrane and the water repellent are completely PFAS-free. The robust and repairable construction will last for many years and puts the forever in BFF. The jacket is made in waterproof and breathable Surpass 2.5L Hardshell™. It’s a wind- and waterproof shell fabric that is both light, silent and stretchy. Together with the cut, this fabric gives the jacket full freedom of movement and unparalleled comfort. BFF Jacket has an adjustable hood and bottom hem, zippered armpit ventilations, front pockets and articulated sleeves with velcro closures. The jacket is fully seam sealed and has water repellent zippers. If you are looking for a soft, silent and light waterproof jacket that will keep you comfortable for many, many years, this is definitely what you're looking for.

The Weather Tee from Houdini is a wind and water resistant t-shirt in a light and highly breathable fabric. Wear it for that little extra weather protection when you're running, kayaking, ski touring or climbing. Only your creativity sets the limits. Weather Tee is a t-shirt with the basic functionality of a light windbreaker. It will shield you from light winds and quick showers. But why the shorts sleeves, you might ask? Weight, comfort and ventilation is the answer. The t-shirt model makes a big difference for your sense of weightlessness and the minimalistic design adds to the feeling. You will barely feel that you're wearing Weather Tee, but that extra protection will keep you warm, comfy and well ventilated at all times. The shirt is made in C9 Ripstop, an ultra light, strong and highly breathable material. It has the perfect air permeability to let your body breathe but still take the edge of a cold draft or sudden gusts of wind. The fabric is made from 70% recycled polyester and 30% polyester. It’s completely recyclable.

The Mono Air Houdi from Houdini is an innovation both in terms of performance and sustainability. The Mono Air fabric is specifically designed to combat plastic waste. It sheds 80% less microfibers compared to conventional fleece and is made from recycled and recyclable materials. A fleece that is both anti-shedding and circular is nothing less than groundbreaking. When you feel the warmth on a cold ski tour in the backcountry, when you snuggle up during a coffee break at the climbing crag, you should also feel the comfort of contributing to a world without waste. In a conventional fleece, the cut-off fibers that create the fuzzy structure are exposed and can therefore shed from the garment during wash or when you use it. In Mono Air, endlessly long and lofty fibers are knitted into small pockets between a face and back fabric. The pockets trap warm air from your body to create insulation and at the same time protect the insulating fibers from escaping. The face of the fabric is reinforced with a hardface treatment that prevent pilling and snagging. The result is a smooth and strong fabric that will keep you warm and endure years of hard use.

Simply put, we believe that it is indeed possible to wear one t-shirt for everything.

The Women’s Tree Message Tee from Houdini is a great combination of classic design and innovative textile technology. All Tencel™ fibers are certified with FSC® or PEFC™, ensuring sustainable forest management and carry the EU Ecolabel. The Tencel™ factory in Lenzig recycles process water and reuses all chemicals at a recovery rate of more than 99%. Wood is a renewable resource and since we never mix natural fibers and synthetics, the fabric is also completely biodegradable.
